title: cashflow-analysis-liquidity-risk-sme-hero
subject: A business owner studies a liquidity trend line and abstract cash-flow bars on a laptop and a simple printed forecast, one dip in the curve subtly highlighted, symbolising liquidity risk becoming visible before it turns critical.
context: Beraterium blog hero for the article on cash-flow analysis and liquidity risk in SME risk management. Theme: cash as the lifeline of a business, liquidity risk as the blind spot. Professional B2B editorial, calm analytical mood, not stock photo.

platform_website.optimized_variants: Build creates cashflow-analyse-risikomanagement-kmu-hero.webp plus -480w, -960w, -1440w responsive WebP from the PNG source
platform_website.best_practice_notes: Wide 16:9 hero; single clear focal point on the liquidity curve; generous negative space in upper third; readable at thumbnail and full width.
platform_website.safe_zone: Keep main subject in central 90% width; avoid critical detail in extreme left/right 5% and bottom 10%.

composition.depth: foreground corner of printed liquidity forecast, midground business owner at desk with laptop showing an abstract cash-flow curve, soft background office with window light

lighting.style: soft natural window light with gentle cinematic falloff

style.mood: analytical, calm, credible — foresight rather than alarm

ai_disclosure.placement: small legible label in the bottom-right corner of the image; never alt-text only
ai_disclosure.prompt_instruction: Small legible caption text 'KI-generiertes Bild' in the bottom-right corner: small clean sans-serif, white at ~70% opacity, unobtrusive but readable.

optional_text_overlay.typography: Prefer no text on image — article H1 renders above hero.
optional_text_overlay.prompt_instruction: No readable numbers or text on screen; abstract curve and bars only.

negative_prompt: no watermarks or text except the small AI-disclosure label bottom right
no readable text or euro amounts on screen (only exception: the small AI-disclosure label bottom right)
no identifiable real persons or celebrities

seo.alt_text: Unternehmer prüft Liquiditätsentwicklung und Cashflow-Kennzahlen auf einem Dashboard im Büro
seo.caption: Eine Cashflow-Analyse macht Liquiditätsrisiken sichtbar, bevor sie kritisch werden.

generation_prompt_single_block_en: Landscape editorial photograph 1920x1080, 16:9. Modern SME office, navy charcoal tones (#1F2A44) with cyan (#00A3FF) and amber (#F2B134) accents on subtle UI elements. Midground: focused business owner in smart casual reviewing an abstract liquidity trend line on a laptop, with a simple printed cash-flow forecast on the desk; one gentle dip in the curve softly highlighted. Foreground: corner of the forecast sheet and a pen. Soft window light from left, medium contrast, calm analytical mood. Generous negative space upper third for blog header. Clean editorial realism, medium-high detail. In the bottom-right corner add a small legible caption text 'KI-generiertes Bild' in a small clean sans-serif, white at about 70% opacity — unobtrusive but readable at full width and thumbnail size. No other readable numbers or text, no watermarks, no third-party logos, no alarm symbols, no stock-photo clichés, no distorted hands. Safe zone: main subject central 90% width.
